description: Should you consolidate credit cards with a personal loan? Compares paying the cards directly (same monthly amount, highest rate first, 0% promo aware) against up to two loan offers, including origination fees, shortfall/extra cash, and early payoff — shows interest+fees by payoff month and the month a fee offer stops being the better deal. Deterministic arithmetic; no credit data.

promo_months_left.description: months left on a 0% promo, if any

monthly_budget.description: monthly amount for the keep-the-cards comparison; defaults to offer A's payment

interest_rate.description: interest rate % (NOT the APR, which already includes the fee)

payoff_months.description: when you expect to pay everything off; defaults to the full term

name: debt_consolidation_check
